mike (eng-platform): Heads-up — saw a spike of ~3% 503s around 09:12 UTC in us-west-2. Primary model (gptx-large) hit GPU pool saturation and we returned rejections. Proposal: implement automatic model-variant fallback on capacity saturation rather than immediate rejection. Tier-aware: premium tenants get fallbacks to compatible quantized variants in-region; free tenants get queued or rate-limited. Thoughts?

anita (eng-runtime): Do you have the trace/metric that shows saturation vs infra OOM?

mike (eng-platform): short query from metrics: fallback_reason = "capacity" spikes aligned with `primary_pool_util` > 0.95. Also saw increased `reject_rate` and p95 latency on fallback candidates when cold.

liz (eng-sre): main concerns: quality regressions and hidden latency/cost. If we silently swap models we need telemetry and SLO guards (p95 latency, top-1 quality regression) + emergency kill-switch.

sara (product): Console needs to show who got auto-fallback and why. Product wants: per-tenant override, per-route opt-out, and a visible cost delta column. Also an audit trail for compliance.

anita (eng-runtime): Implementation sketch: routing service adds a 'fallback pipeline' with ordered compatible variant list. On capacity signal -> pick first compatible variant in same region that meets compatibility score threshold (tokenizer + architecture + max_seq). If none, escalate to regional fallback or queue. Keep sticky mapping for active sessions for X minutes.

mike (eng-platform): example policy config (draft):

```yaml
fallback_policy:
  tiers:
    premium:
      prefer_same_region: true
      variants: ["gptx-large-8bit", "gptx-medium-8bit"]
      max_fallback_rate: 0.2  # fraction of requests that can be auto-fallbacked
    free:
      policy: queue_or_429
  global_guardrails:
    max_global_fallback: 0.05
    kill_switch_metric: "regression_alerts"
```

anita (eng-runtime): Nice. A few details:
- compatibility_score needs to be computed offline and stored in model metadata.
- fallback decision should be atomic with request allocation to avoid double-spends.
- backoff: if a chosen variant is also saturated, mark it with short penalty and try next.

liz (eng-sre): Telemetry we need (events + metrics): `fallback_triggered{tenant,route,variant}`, `fallback_reason`, `variant_selected`, `original_latency`, `fallback_latency`, `quality_delta` (from eval hooks). Also histograms for p95/p99 post-fallback. If `quality_delta` > threshold -> auto-rollback.

ryan (ops-bot): Suggest auto-alert rule: if fallback_rate_premium > 0.15 for > 10m AND error_rate rises -> page oncall. We can add runbook link: https://go/rr-fallback-runbook

sara (product): UX: rollout control in Console: slider for canary % (0-100), per-tenant overrides list, visible churn column (est. token cost delta). Also expose `why` text for each fallback event.

anita (eng-runtime): For rollout safety, add these: `canary_percent`, `ramp_interval`, `max_regression_violations`. API example: `POST /v1/rollouts` with `policy_id`, `canary_percent`, `duration`, `kill_switch_thresholds`.

mike (eng-platform): Plan proposal:
1) implement routing decision + model metadata changes (2 sprints)
2) wire telemetry events for fallback + console surface (1 sprint)
3) pilot: select 10 premium tenants, canary 20% traffic for 7 days, monitor `quality_delta` and cost.

liz (eng-sre): +1 if you include automatic rollback when `quality_delta` > 0.03 or `p95` increases by > 200ms for 10m. Need ETA on dashboard widgets.

sara (product): fine with pilot. we'll prepare comms + tenant opt-in list. Also finalize billing display for cost delta.

mike (eng-platform): I'll open an RFC with the config schema, API changes, and telemetry spec today. Will include a sample console mock.

anita (eng-runtime): One more: prefer region-local variants to avoid cross-region egress. If none available, fall back to cross-region with higher cost bucket and explicit consent flag.

mike (eng-platform): noted. We'll default to no cross-region fallback unless tenant has `allow_cross_region_fallback=true`.

liz (eng-sre): :thumbsup: Also add a synthetic regression test suite run as part of rollout (sample prompts + automated eval).

ryan (ops-bot): Auto-scheduled task created: `fallback-rollout-monitor` will post daily summary to #eng-sre during pilot.

mike (eng-platform): Thanks all — I'll start the RFC and tag people for review.

sara (product): thanks — excited to try this, should save a lot of rejected requests during spikes :rocket:
